overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the generic 'Town Administrator Updates' topic was acceptable for status reports, and off-notice discussion was permitted because the chair did not anticipate it 48 hours ahead. The March 13 notice allegation was declined as outside the original complaint.

allegations.summary: The January 24 notice's 'Town Administrator Updates' topic gave no description of what would be discussed, allegedly making the notice insufficiently detailed.
allegations.key_passage: We understand that under this topic the Town Administrator provides status updates to the Board and that these updates are generally not pieces of business that Board members anticipate discussing.

allegations.summary: Clayton Mill River Road culvert matters were raised under 'Town Administrator Updates' on January 24 though not listed on that notice.
allegations.key_passage: As such, the chair did not reasonably anticipate discussions pertaining to Clayton Mill River Road 48 hours prior to the meeting.

allegations.summary: The complaint's April 3 filing also alleged the March 13 meeting notice lacked sufficient detail and suggested other notices might be deficient.
allegations.key_passage: We decline to review the allegation regarding the March 13 meeting notice because it was not included within the February 22 complaint and the Board has not had an opportunity to respond to it.
